title: Helion Energy full-window hero
description: A hero exactly one window tall: full-bleed footage edge to edge and a two-line all-caps heading (32px on phones, 55px at 1440, line height 0.92) set low on the left with its first line stepped in. No motion of its own; the footage carries it.
notes: always dark (it carries the `dark` class) so the heading stays light over footage
media is the film or photo; empty it is a dark placeholder surface
pair with helionenergy-header (fixed) floating over it
name: helionenergy-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the heading's lines, broken on every width; the first line is stepped in

props.name: media
props.description: the full-bleed film or photo behind it (cropped like object-fit: cover)
